what: Draws a ribbon on canvas where 24 thin strands twist into one band and unravel — each strand’s phase is shifted by .14 and two sines are layered (frequency .75, twist .41, center bulge .66), with the second sine rotating over time (.7 per second × speed .66) so the band twists slowly. Color blends strand by strand from the accent color to lime green, and the outer 25% at both ends fades. When first visible, strands are drawn over 1.5s at .6~1× speeds (smoothstep), and once fully drawn, an 88px light tail (purple, orange, sky, pink) runs on about one strand in three every 3 seconds. The 1720×1080 design board is stretched to cover the element and pauses when off screen

options.speed: Twist speed multiplier, default .66 (hero and scale section of a docs site)
options.rotate: Band tilt (degrees), default 0 — the Brand hero uses -28, from lower left to upper right
options.plen · psize: Light trail length and thickness (design-board px), default 88 · 3
options.sparse: Share of strands with tails, default .32
options.particles: off means line only, no tail
options.intro: Seconds before the first stroke is drawn, default 1.5 — at 0 everything shows at once
options.from · to: Names of the two CSS variables at the ends of the strand color — default is --kf-accent and that color turned toward lime

note: Lays a canvas at the very front of the element (absolute position, does not block clicks). Content placed above it gets position: relative; Lifted with z-index: 1. The color is made relative to the Skin’s --kf-accent and read as pixels, so it follows when the Skin changes

from.where: index.html .m-hero (ribbon tilted -28° behind the hero) · .m-scale__ribbon (304px band in the scale section)
